intent: A four-step onboarding pager for a focus app where a swipe moves one day forward: the sky blends from dawn to golden hour, SVG hills parallax under an arcing sun, a grove grows on the meadow and a glass card carries the copy.

apis: Animated (one pos value in pages drives everything)
stack.web: react-native-web compatible; JS driver on web, native driver elsewhere

layout.sky: full-bleed; one 3-stop LinearGradient per step stacked, layer i opacity clamp(pos - (i - 1))
layout.topBar: top 54pt, 44pt tall; glass Back circle (40pt) left, centred brand mark + wordmark, glass Skip pill (40pt) right
layout.scene: far ridge base 146pt above the card, middle hills 100pt, meadow 56pt; the meadow continues behind the card
layout.chips: one auto-width glass chip per step (max 300pt), 84 or 132pt above the horizon, opposite the sun
layout.card: glass, 12pt inset from the sides and bottom, 336pt tall (304 compact), radius 32; progress + clock row, copy area, 56pt pill button

color.glass: BlurView light tint (30-36 chips, 60 card); warm wash rgba(255,252,247,0.86) to rgba(255,249,241,0.72); 50% white hairline; inset 0 1px 0 white 85% top edge
color.button: #24352C to #121C17; last step #2F5E45 to #1C3A2B with amber glaze; planted #3E7A57
color.grain: 96pt SVG pattern of 220 1pt dots, white 10% and ink 4.5%

motion.drag: 1:1; rubber band (1 - 1/(o*0.55 + 1)) * 0.6 pages past the ends; release projects pos + v*0.22s, snaps at most one page, spring stiffness 320 damping 30 with release velocity
motion.sun: arc x 22% to 80%, y horizon - 34 - sin(pi t)*150; dawn, day and gold versions crossfade
motion.trees: 13 SVG trees grow from the bottom as pos nears their page (page - 0.75 to page - 0.05)
motion.progress: dots built from caps plus a scaleX bar; widths 7/26/7pt interpolated per page so the pill stretches and passes along
motion.buttons: Continue/Back 560ms ease-in-out (0.65,0,0.35,1); Skip 760ms through every sky
motion.entrance: 760ms ease-out: hills rise 10/18/28pt, sun 24pt, chips 14pt, card 28pt
motion.ambient: the breath chip's dot inhales 0.7 to 1.15 over 2.4s while active; nothing else loops
motion.press: scale 0.97 over 90ms, spring back stiffness 420 damping 22
motion.finish: final tree springs (stiffness 200, damping 17) with gold glow; 14 SVG leaves burst in a 170 degree fan over 1.1s with an amber ring and halo bloom; label swaps to a drawn check + 'Planted. See you at 7:30'; onFinish at 1.1s
motion.reducedMotion: no parallax, the grove spreads across one view, 140ms page changes, no entrance travel, breathing or burst

responsive.height: compact layout under 760pt (card 304pt, title 28pt); never hard-codes the device height

accessibility: Back, Skip and the main button have accessibilityRole button, labels and state
copy area is adjustable, labelled with the current title and body, value 'Step n of 4', increment/decrement actions page
decorative SVG sits inside aria-hidden wrappers

steps: Start small: Two quiet minutes still count. (chip 2:00 Morning breath)
Grow something: Every session plants a tree. (chip Deep work, 25 min, +1)
Look back: Watch the week take shape. (chip 14 trees this week, 7 bars)
Begin: Plant your first tree. (chip Tomorrow, 7:30)

avoid: Lottie, images, emoji or icon packs
crossfading skies that go grey mid-drag
pagination that jumps instead of morphing
animating width or layout during the drag
parallax layer edges showing during overscroll
confetti or anything that bounces more than once
